summary: A1-C2 integrated into the shared runtime engine across this task's full resume history (A1 arcs 6-7, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2, one shared vocabulary-catalogue merge per level). This final session wired C2: level registration (available:false), a full levels/c2/evaluators.js (13 intents, 3 of them reused bare intent ids from B2/C1 via ctx.canDoId branching), the two real scoring dimensions (registerAppropriateness/discourseCoherence) against C2's own opt-in tables, the new multi-turn evaluation span core-engine feature (ctx.spanTurns, additive, no other level's evaluation changed), the multi-capability delayed-retrieval requirement for the capstone (learnerModel.js's new recordDelayedRetrievalEvidence, purely evidentiary/additive), C2's vocabulary/pattern catalogue merge (143 words + 10 patterns), C2's own i18n merge (558 episode-UI keys + 119 evaluator praise/retry keys, the latter caught only by running a real functional walkthrough, not by structural checks alone), and UI-adjacent tables (SessionRunner MODEL_ANSWER/PROMPT, formatChoice OBJECTIVE_FORMATS). Also repaired two real pre-existing integration defects unrelated to C2's own wiring: a literal, never-interpolated {{learnerInterest}} template token in five C2 content steps, and 170 B2/C1 evaluator praise/retry i18n keys that were referenced since those levels were wired in but never merged (learners would have seen the raw key string). Five structural check scripts had hardcoded per-level ternary/subtraction chains stopping at C1 (check-curriculum-map's dead-evaluator regex, check-curriculum-authoring's declaredArcs/canDoIntentMapOf, check-curriculum-loading, check-placement-honesty, check-pre-a1-freeze's catalogue-share subtraction) — all fixed to know about C2, following the exact shape each already used for the level before it. Bundle budgets raised twice with the same measured-not-guessed justification every earlier bump in this file documented (ENTRY_BUDGET_KB 800->850, LOCALE_MAX_KB 280->310), both after confirming check-curriculum-loading's finer-grained app-code/curriculum-data gates still had real headroom. C2 remains available:false and unreachable by any real learner flow; A1 remains unavailable; Pre-A1 frozen at 17 episodes (verified by check-pre-a1-freeze after the fix). Two consecutive full clean QA cycles (frontend check:all + build + check-bundle-boundaries, backend compileall + pytest 468/468, Foundry scope guard, C2's own scripts/foundry/c2/run-all.mjs) with zero edits between them, after the last fix. A scripted functional walkthrough of a real C2 episode (levels/c2/arcs/c2Arc1DenseInputSynthesis.js's extract_key_argument_from_dense_text) through the real evaluator/learner-model pipeline is recorded in the PR body: wrong answer correctly rejected and retried, assisted vs. independent evidence correctly distinguished, praise/retry copy resolves to real English (not a raw key), episode completion is not double-awarded on replay. Provider-free hybrid-fixture coreEngineRequirement is satisfied by construction (C2's own local structural-floor evaluators serve as the deterministic CI/QA verdict regardless of remote availability, matching the same pattern every level below it already uses); no new backend/provider fixture code was added, since no earlier level (B1/B2/C1) built that either and CI/QA was already, and remains, fully provider-free.
